A '''Defel male''' was trained as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. During the [[Swarm War]] the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] was training to become a Jedi at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Academy]]. When [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] visited the [[academy]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] was partaking in a game of [[Skorch]], serving as the referee.
